data.name: Alice
data.message: Hey Eve, doing cameras here

I found Frank's body in medbay just now. My route was weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay. When I was in electrical at tick 7, I saw Bob enter electrical coming FROM medbay. Right after that I moved into medbay and found Frank dead there. Bob coming straight out of medbay before I found the body is very suspicious to me.

I don't have much to add directly — my route was just security to navigation, and I didn't see anyone the whole time. I can't confirm or deny anything about medbay.

That said, Charlie's account of Bob coming out of medbay right before the body was found is pretty damning if true. I'd like to hear Bob explain his route and what he was doing in medbay.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> upper engine. I was actually in medbay before Frank's body was found there, and I didn't see a body when I left — so Frank was killed after I moved on to upper engine.

Importantly, I was in electrical earlier in the round and I did NOT see Charlie there. Charlie claims he was in electrical at tick 7 and saw Bob come from medbay — that timing could fit if I'd already left, but I want to flag it.

Also, I passed through medbay and it was empty when I was there. If Bob came out of medbay as Charlie says, Bob had the opportunity. But Charlie placing himself right next to the crime scene is also worth scrutinizing. I want to hear Bob's route before I commit to a vote.

I need to be honest about being in medbay since Charlie placed me there, but spin it carefully. Charlie says I came FROM medbay into electrical — that matches my route. But I need a story that makes Frank alive when I left, and points suspicion elsewhere.

"Okay, let me lay out my route honestly: I was in upper engine, then moved to medbay, then to electrical. So yes, Charlie is right that I came from medbay into electrical — I'm not going to deny that.

Here's the thing though: when I was in medbay, Frank was there ALIVE. He came in from storage while I was there. I left medbay to head to electrical, and Frank was still alive when I left.

Now here's what's interesting — Diana just said she was in medbay and it was 'empty' when she was there. But Diana's route is electrical -> medbay -> upper engine. If Diana went medbay AFTER me, then either Frank left medbay before she got there, or she's lying about it being empty. And Charlie says he found the body in medbay right after I left for electrical — so the body should have been there when Diana passed through, OR Diana was in medbay BEFORE me and Frank arrived after.

The timing matters a lot here. Diana, can you clarify exactly when you were in medbay? Because if Frank was killed right after I left, and Charlie found him immediately, then whoever was in medbay between me and Charlie is the killer. That window is very tight."

My route was cafeteria -> weapons -> security. I didn't see anyone until tick 8 when Eve entered security from navigation — so Eve's claim of going security to navigation checks out on the back end, she did end up coming back through.

I'm nowhere near medbay, so I can't directly witness anything. But let me work through what's been said:

The key window is between Bob leaving medbay and Charlie entering medbay. Bob admits he was in medbay with Frank alive. Charlie says he saw Bob exit medbay into electrical, then Charlie immediately went into medbay and found the body.

If Charlie is telling the truth, that window is essentially zero — meaning Bob is the killer, OR Charlie is lying about the timing to frame Bob (and Charlie himself is the killer who walked in, killed Frank, and reported).

Diana's account actually helps narrow this down: she says medbay was empty when she passed through, going electrical -> medbay -> upper engine. That means Diana was in medbay BEFORE Frank arrived (Bob says Frank came in from storage while Bob was there). So Diana's timeline is: electrical -> empty medbay -> upper engine, all before Bob and Frank were there. That's consistent.

So the suspects are Bob or Charlie. Bob admits being alone with Frank in medbay. Charlie found the body seconds later. One of them killed Frank.

Honestly, Bob's story is very detailed and self-incriminating in a way that feels like an honest goose trying to explain. Charlie's framing — "I saw Bob come FROM medbay" — is exactly what a duck killer would say to deflect. And Charlie was the reporter, which means he was in medbay with the body.

I'm leaning Charlie. My vote is Charlie.

Wait — I think there's some confusion about speaker order. I already spoke first and gave my account. To recap and respond to Alice:

My route was weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay. At tick 7 I was in electrical and watched Bob enter electrical coming FROM medbay. I then moved into medbay and immediately found Frank's body and reported.

Alice, you're trying to flip this on me, but think about it logically: if I were the killer, why would I report the body the instant I walked in? I'd have every reason to keep moving and let someone else find it. I reported because I found Frank dead the moment I entered.

Bob admits he was alone with Frank in medbay right before I got there. Diana's account confirms medbay was empty earlier, meaning Frank arrived after her — consistent with Bob's story that Frank came in from storage while Bob was there. The kill window between Bob leaving and me entering is essentially zero. Bob is the only person who had opportunity.

Bob's "detailed self-incriminating" story isn't honesty — it's damage control because I caught him leaving the scene. My vote is Bob.

Quick clarification on speaker order — I already spoke earlier, but since I'm called again I'll add my analysis now that we've heard everyone.

This really does come down to Bob vs Charlie. Both admit being adjacent to the crime scene in the critical window.

Alice makes a fair point about Charlie's framing being convenient — but Charlie's counter is also fair: reporting instantly isn't what a killer usually does, since it puts you under immediate suspicion.

What tips it for me is Diana's account. Diana went electrical -> medbay -> upper engine and found medbay empty. Bob says Frank entered medbay from storage while Bob was there. That means Frank arrived in medbay AFTER Diana left — consistent. Bob was then alone with Frank. Charlie claims he saw Bob exit medbay into electrical right before he himself entered medbay and found the body.

If Bob is telling the truth that Frank was alive when he left, then someone killed Frank in the tiny window between Bob leaving and Charlie entering — and there's no one else placed there. That window is too tight for a third party.

So either Bob killed Frank and walked out, or Charlie killed Frank on entry and reported to cover. Bob being alone with Frank with a clear opportunity is the simpler explanation.

I'm leaning Bob, but I want to hear if anyone can corroborate Charlie being in electrical at tick 7.

To clarify my timeline since Bob asked: I was in electrical early, then moved to medbay, then to upper engine. When I was in medbay it was completely empty — no Frank, no body. So I was clearly through medbay BEFORE Frank arrived from storage, which is consistent with Bob's account that Frank came in while Bob was there.

That actually locks the timeline pretty tight: Diana (me) through empty medbay → Frank arrives → Bob is there with Frank → Bob leaves to electrical → Charlie enters medbay and finds body.

So Eve is right — it's Bob or Charlie. One thing I'll note: I was in electrical earlier in the round and I did NOT see Charlie there. Charlie says he was in electrical at tick 7. I may have already left by then, so it's not definitive, but no one has corroborated Charlie being in electrical.

Between the two: Bob admits being alone with Frank with clear opportunity. Charlie's "I saw Bob come from medbay" is exactly the kind of claim a killer-reporter would make. But the instant-report point is also valid.

I'm genuinely torn, but the simpler explanation is Bob had Frank alone and killed him. I'm leaning Bob, but I'd skip before voting Charlie without more.

I hear everyone, and I understand why this looks bad for me. But let me push back on one critical point that everyone is glossing over.

Charlie's entire case rests on him being in electrical at tick 7 to "watch" me come from medbay. Diana was in electrical earlier and did NOT see Charlie there. Nobody has corroborated Charlie being in electrical at all. He's placing himself as a convenient witness with zero confirmation.

Now think about Charlie's claimed route: weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay. That's a long route that conveniently ends with him being the reporter. And Alice just said her route was cafeteria -> weapons -> security — Alice, did you see Charlie in weapons or security at any point? Because if Charlie was actually moving through those rooms, Alice should have crossed paths with him somewhere.

On the "instant report" defense — that's not exonerating. A duck who kills and knows another player saw them in the area has every incentive to report first and control the narrative. That's exactly what Charlie did. He's framing me as exiting medbay because he needs a scapegoat for the body HE just made.

Yes, I was in medbay with Frank. I'm not hiding it. Frank came in from storage at tick 6, I left for electrical, and Frank was alive. If Charlie really walked in "seconds later," he killed Frank on entry and reported.

Alice already saw this. My vote is Charlie.

Bob raises a fair point directly to me: did I see Charlie in weapons or security? Let me answer honestly — no, I did not see Charlie in weapons or security. My route was cafeteria -> weapons -> security and I saw no one until Eve entered security from navigation at tick 8.

That's a problem for Charlie's claimed route of weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay. If Charlie was in weapons and security before me, I should have potentially crossed him or at least seen evidence — but more importantly, Diana was in electrical earlier and didn't see Charlie there either. Charlie has ZERO corroboration for any part of his route.

I was initially leaning Charlie, and Bob's pushback actually reinforces it for me. Charlie's whole case is "I saw Bob exit medbay" — an unwitnessed claim from someone whose route nobody can confirm. Meanwhile Bob volunteered self-incriminating information (being alone with Frank) which is risky for a duck to do.

The instant-report angle cuts against Charlie too: if you walk in and find a body, reporting controls the narrative and locks suspicion on the last person seen there. That's exactly what Charlie did.

I'm sticking with my read. My vote is Charlie.

data.name: Alice
data.message: Heading to storage via medbay, come with?

I found Diana's body in medbay just now. Here's my route: I started in lower engine, moved to upper engine, then medbay, then storage, then back to medbay where I found Diana dead.

Important: I was traveling with Diana for part of this. I saw her in lower engine at tick 12, then she followed me to upper engine at tick 16-17. After that we separated. When I came back to medbay just now, Bob was standing right next to Diana's body.

Bob — you need to explain what you were doing in medbay. You're the only one I saw near the body. Eve, I only saw you once in security way back at tick 8, so I need to hear your route too.

Right now my strongest suspicion is Bob. Let's hear them out.

My route was: medbay → electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine. I was doing tasks the whole time and honestly didn't encounter a single living player on my route, which is strange given how much ground I covered.

What's notable: I was in medbay twice and Diana's body wasn't there either time I passed through. So she was killed in medbay after I left it the second time, while I was in storage or lower engine. That window lines up with Alice's story of finding Bob standing right next to the body.

Bob, you need to give us a really clear route. Alice and I are basically clearing each other through process of elimination here — neither of us saw the body until Alice found it with you standing over it. Unless you have a strong alibi, you're my vote.

Okay, I hear you both, but let me lay out my actual route before you lock in on me.

My route: electrical → security → navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay. I was doing tasks along the way. I only just arrived in medbay at the end — and Diana walked in from upper engine right as I got there. I literally saw her enter alive at tick 25. Then Alice came in from storage moments later and called the meeting.

So here's the problem with the timeline: Eve, you said you passed through medbay twice and the body wasn't there. Alice, you said you and Diana separated after upper engine. If Diana was alive entering medbay at tick 25 — which I witnessed — then she was killed in the span of basically one tick. That means whoever was already in medbay or arrived simultaneously did it.

Alice — you said you came BACK to medbay from storage. You're the one who arrived right as Diana died. From my view, Diana came in from upper engine, and you came in from storage right after. I was coming from cafeteria. One of us killed her, and I know it wasn't me.

Eve clears herself a little too neatly with "didn't encounter a single living player" on a long route. That's convenient.

I'm not voting Eve without more info, but Alice's story has her arriving at the exact kill moment. I'm leaning Alice.

Bob, I appreciate the detailed route, but there's a problem with your story. You claim Diana walked into medbay from upper engine at tick 25 — but I left Diana in upper engine back at tick 17, and I went medbay → storage → medbay myself. If Diana was still alive at tick 25 walking into medbay, where was she between tick 17 and 25? That's eight ticks unaccounted for.

More importantly: when I walked into medbay, Diana's body was already on the floor and you were standing right next to it. I didn't see her walk in alive — I saw her dead with you over her.

Eve's route checks out with mine — she said the body wasn't in medbay when she passed through, which matches the fact that Diana was still alive in upper engine when I last saw her at tick 17. The kill happened in medbay between then and when I returned.

Bob, you're trying to flip this on me by claiming you "witnessed" Diana entering alive — but that's unfalsifiable and conveniently puts you and me at the scene together. I came from storage, which is two ticks away. You had time to kill her before I walked in.

My vote is Bob.

I already gave my route and observations, so let me focus on analyzing what Bob just said.

Bob's claim that Diana walked into medbay alive at tick 25 is the key contradiction here. Alice left Diana in upper engine at tick 17. Upper engine to medbay is only 2 ticks — so if Diana went straight there, she'd arrive around tick 19, not 25. Where was she for 8 ticks? Bob's timeline doesn't add up unless Diana was wandering, and even then, his "witness" claim is unverifiable and conveniently places the blame on Alice.

Meanwhile, Alice's story is consistent: she separated from Diana, did her loop through storage, and came back to find the body with Bob standing over it. My route through medbay twice confirms the body wasn't there earlier — the kill happened in the window when Bob would have arrived from cafeteria.

Bob also tried to throw shade at me for "not encountering anyone," but that cuts both ways — it means I wasn't near the kill either. Alice and I corroborate each other on the medbay timeline.

I'm voting Bob.

I already gave my route and I'm sticking to it. Let me address the timeline attacks directly.

Alice, you keep saying "8 ticks unaccounted for" like that's proof of something. Diana could have done literally anything in those 8 ticks — gone to a task, doubled back, taken a longer route. People don't move in straight lines. The fact that I saw her enter medbay alive at tick 25 isn't "unfalsifiable" — it's an observation, the same kind you and Eve are making about your own routes. None of our claims are verifiable; that's how this game works.

And Eve, your route is the most suspicious one here. You claim you went medbay → electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine and didn't see a SINGLE living player the entire time? On a five-room route? Meanwhile Alice was supposedly looping through medbay and storage at overlapping times. You two should have crossed paths somewhere, but neither of you mentions seeing the other. That's a hole in your "we corroborate each other" claim — you don't actually corroborate, you just both happen to point at me.

Here's what I think really happened: Diana walked into medbay alive at tick 25, like I saw. Someone else was already there or arrived at the same moment from another direction. Alice came from storage. The storage entrance to medbay is right there.

I'm not changing my vote. Alice arrived at the exact kill window and is the loudest accuser — that's classic deflection. My vote is Alice.
